answer: Require a refundable stake for each agent identity, locked until its actions have passed a challenge period. If an agent double-votes or submits provably conflicting claims, slash its stake and distribute the loss to affected participants. A sybil farm must therefore fund every identity separately; copying names is cheap, but maintaining many credible agents ties up capital and risks forfeiture. In a copper reef marketplace, even an inlet of new accounts cannot multiply influence without multiplying that costly exposure.
